source: roadmap 00006-cms-redesign r04 tech-notes §6 (KD01–KD19), r05 decisions 1, 2, 4 (KD20–KD22). Figma is frozen; code wins (Q5).

treatments.token: parity checks the code token, not the Figma value
treatments.ignore-colour: overlay and landmarks ignore colour in the scope
treatments.mask: region excluded from the overlay heat map
treatments.geometry-tolerance: landmark geometry compared within the tolerance
treatments.no-reference: no Figma reference; parity and contrast only

differences.code: before PageHeader lands: icon-only back controls are 32 px ghost IconButtons (40 px hit area on a phone); labelled ones ghost sm BasicButtons with the same hit area

differences.figma: search field icon leading
differences.code: BasicInput icon is leading (the text starts after it); FormField labels carry for (a click focuses the control), the required * sits before the ? help button; BasicDatePicker trigger looks like an input with the calendar icon

multi-choice lists are BasicSelect multiple („Wybrano: N” for several, the plain label as placeholder); confirmations with a custom footer are BasicModal (a bottom sheet on a phone); the Builder section order is the labelled FloatingActions pill
the rich-text toolbar formatting tools are outline sm IconButtons with a pressed state (H1–H3 stay text buttons, R7); the text / table mode switch is a BasicSelect
